story_type: two sailors in cold water after capsizing, basket hoist from the water
hook: Their sailboats capsized. Two men in cold water, six miles out.
narration: Their sailboats capsized, and two men ended up in the cold water off Washington.
This was about six miles northwest of Port Townsend, in the Strait of Juan de Fuca.
A Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter crew found them and moved in over the top.
In water this cold, hands and arms can stop working within minutes, so the crew sends down a basket they only have to roll into.
The hoist operator lowered it right beside the first man.
He pulled himself in, and rode the cable up to the cabin door.
[short pause] Then the basket went back down for the second man.
He climbed in too, soaked through, and held on all the way up.
outcome: The aircrew hoisted both men aboard and flew them to medical crews waiting in Port Angeles.
title: Sailboats capsized, 2 men in cold water
description:
On June 13, 2022, a Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin aircrew hoisted two men from the water after the sailing vessels they were aboard capsized about 6 miles northwest of Port Townsend, Washington. Both were showing signs of hypothermia and were taken to emergency medical services in Port Angeles.
